acts: AIFC Rules No. FR0001 of 2017 (General Rules)

en.title: AFSA online rulebook, GEN 4.3.2: the integrity principle is printed under the heading of Principle 2
en.summary: In GEN V20 (aifc.kz) 4.3.2 requires each Approved Individual and Designated Individual to "act with due skill, care and diligence". On the AFSA online rulebook the text under "4.3.2. Principle 2 - Due skill, care and diligence" is the integrity sentence of 4.3.1, so the due skill principle for individuals is missing online.
en.correction: Restore the text of GEN 4.3.2 on the online rulebook.

quotes.text: Each Approved Individual and Designated Individual must act with due skill, care and diligence
